correctness.rationale: Exact mixed density via Euler operators; four corner evaluations give necessity, parameter pole excludes theta>1. The standalone checker reconstructed the numerator and certified 160 rational Bernstein coefficients in two exhaustive p regimes with exact nonnegative polynomial coefficients, proving global density positivity. Boundary continuity and all margins are proved in RESULT.md. No infinite statement is inferred from numerical sampling.

value.rationale: A natural multivariate ratio extension whose bivariate margins are exactly independence yet three-way dependence is nontrivial admits a sharp complete parameter region. The phase p=1 changes upper bound. This gives concrete valid model choices for hidden higher-order association and exact boundaries, not a routine renaming.
